title: Nice stickers for sealing my envelopes but no colors are vibrant
text:
Nice stickers for sealing my envelopes but no colors are vibrant. These hearts are just okay. Their colors are not vibrant. In fact, the silver and gold are dull.   Also, removing the hearts from the paper is a delicate process. I actually ripped one because I pulled it off too fast.

Overall, these work to add to the seal of any envelopes I am mailing out. I really would not use them for much else due to their lackluster look. 

The current price of $9.99 comes to almost $.2 cents per heart which is too much for this style.
